Notification._comment: Notification also fires on idle_prompt, agent_completed, auth_success and more, so an unmatched red hook paints tabs that want nothing. The matcher is the notification_type, and for a plain [a-zA-Z0-9_|] pattern Claude Code splits on | and compares exactly. Allowlist, so an unrecognised type stays quiet instead of crying wolf.

idle_prompt means the opposite of red: nothing is happening and the prompt is yours. Painting it green is what makes a stale red heal itself, since an idle session fires no other event. It cannot stomp a real red, because idle_prompt only fires when the session is not loading and no dialog is open.
